cells.name: default
cells.species: the default material: 3 px frost, 22 px rim lensing, 34 px bezel, 24 px slab, n = 1.5

cells.name: clear
cells.species: clear — transparent, strong lensing (2 px frost, 26 px strength, 36 px bezel)

cells.name: thin
cells.species: thin — 6 px frost, 18 px strength, 26 px bezel

cells.name: regular
cells.species: regular — frosted, softer lensing (14 px frost, 16 px strength)

cells.name: thick
cells.species: thick — 22 px frost, 12 px strength, 28 px bezel

cells.name: ultra
cells.species: ultra — 30 px frost, 10 px strength, the heaviest frost

cells.name: lens_only
cells.species: refraction alone: no frost, tint, rings or shadow — the displacement field on its own

cells.name: high_index
cells.species: n = 2.2: the same bezel bends light much further (Δ grows with n)

cells.name: low_index
cells.species: n = 1.15: barely more than air — the lens almost disappears

cells.name: wide_bezel
cells.species: a 70 px bezel on a 44 px slab: the bend spreads deep into the element

cells.name: knife_bezel
cells.species: a 10 px bezel: all the bending in a thin bright band at the rim

cells.name: dispersion
cells.species: chromatic aberration at 1.0 with 30 px strength: R, G, B refract at 0.90×, 1×, 1.14×

cells.name: pill
cells.species: a capsule: bezel clamped to half the height, so it becomes a full dome with no ridge

cells.name: circle
cells.species: a disc: the dome case in the round

cells.name: sharp
cells.species: 6 px corners: the corner-circle branch of the SDF nearly vanishes

cells.name: light_side
cells.species: light from 90°: the two rim lobes swing to the sides

cells.name: light_page
cells.species: the light-backdrop pass: luminance 0.8 drives brighter rims and a grey drop shadow

cells.name: map
cells.species: the displacement map the engine would rasterize: R = dx, G = dy, neutral grey at 128

gens.title: Drift · the glass crosses the backdrop
